title: courier.notification.queued payload
description: The data payload of the courier.notification.queued event: a message is handed to the sending provider. `notification_id` is reserved by NOBODY, which is the point of this fixture — an ordinary name that merely sounds like something another service might have reserved has to stay green, or the rule reports everything and is therefore read as reporting nothing.

notification_id.description: The notification's own row id, and equal to the envelope's subject.
